name: Crazy Logs
author: Desvelao
description: Cross the river on spinning logs as many times as you can before time runs out. Most crossings wins.

objective.en: Cross the river as many times as you can before time runs out. Most crossings wins.
objective.es: Cruza el río tantas veces como puedas antes de que acabe el tiempo. Gana quien más cruces haga.
objective.fr: Traverse la rivière autant de fois que possible avant la fin du temps. Le plus de traversées gagne.
objective.de: Überquere den Fluss so oft du kannst, bevor die Zeit abläuft. Die meisten Überquerungen gewinnen.
objective.pt: Atravessa o rio o maior número de vezes possível antes de o tempo acabar. Ganha quem tiver mais travessias.
objective.it: Attraversa il fiume più volte che puoi prima che scada il tempo. Vince chi ha più attraversamenti.

rules.en: Hop from log to log to reach the far bank: each crossing is 1 point, then you start again from the beginning.
rules.es: Salta de tronco en tronco hasta la otra orilla: cada cruce vale 1 punto y vuelves a empezar desde el principio.
rules.fr: Saute de tronc en tronc pour atteindre l’autre rive : chaque traversée vaut 1 point, puis tu repars du début.
rules.de: Hüpfe von Baumstamm zu Baumstamm bis zum anderen Ufer: Jede Überquerung bringt 1 Punkt, dann beginnst du von vorn.
rules.pt: Salta de tronco em tronco até à margem oposta: cada travessia vale 1 ponto e depois recomeças do início.
rules.it: Salta di tronco in tronco per raggiungere l’altra riva: ogni attraversamento vale 1 punto, poi ricominci dall’inizio.

rules.en: Fall in the river and you restart from the start bank, losing time (not points).
rules.es: Si caes al río vuelves a empezar desde la orilla de salida y pierdes tiempo (no puntos).
rules.fr: Si tu tombes à l’eau, tu repars de la rive de départ en perdant du temps (pas de points).
rules.de: Wenn du ins Wasser fällst, startest du am Startufer neu und verlierst Zeit (keine Punkte).
rules.pt: Se caíres ao rio, recomeças na margem inicial e perdes tempo (não pontos).
rules.it: Se cadi nel fiume, riparti dalla riva di partenza perdendo tempo (non punti).

rules.en: Logs start still. Where you stand spins them: near the middle keeps them calm, the far half pushes them one way, the near half the other; crossing the middle reverses a slow spin.
rules.es: Los troncos empiezan quietos. Donde te pones los hace girar: cerca del centro están tranquilos, la mitad lejana los empuja hacia un lado y la cercana hacia el otro; pasar el centro invierte un giro lento.
rules.fr: Les troncs sont immobiles au départ. L’endroit où tu te tiens les fait tourner : près du milieu, ils restent calmes, la moitié éloignée les pousse dans un sens, la moitié proche dans l’autre ; traverser le milieu inverse une rotation lente.
rules.de: Die Stämme stehen anfangs still. Wo du stehst, bringt sie zum Drehen: In der Nähe der Mitte bleiben sie ruhig, die ferne Hälfte dreht sie in die eine Richtung, die nahe in die andere; wer die Mitte überquert, kehrt eine langsame Drehung um.
rules.pt: Os troncos começam parados. O sítio onde estás faz com que girem: perto do meio mantêm-se calmos, a metade distante empurra-os para um lado, a metade próxima para o outro; atravessar o meio inverte uma rotação lenta.
rules.it: I tronchi all’inizio sono fermi. Dove ti trovi li fa ruotare: vicino al centro restano calmi, la metà lontana li spinge in un verso, quella vicina nell’altro; attraversare il centro inverte una rotazione lenta.

rules.en: The action button hops in the direction you hold, or straight ahead, to the next log.
rules.es: El botón de acción salta en la dirección que mantienes, o hacia delante, al siguiente tronco.
rules.fr: Le bouton d’action saute dans la direction que tu maintiens, ou tout droit, jusqu’au tronc suivant.
rules.de: Der Aktionsknopf hüpft in die Richtung, die du hältst, oder geradeaus, zum nächsten Stamm.
rules.pt: O botão de ação salta na direção que seguras, ou em frente, para o tronco seguinte.
rules.it: Il pulsante azione salta nella direzione che tieni, o dritto, fino al tronco successivo.

rules.en: With water jets on, geysers erupt from the river and shove you and the logs: watch the warning rings.
rules.es: Con los chorros de agua activados, brotan géiseres del río que te empujan a ti y a los troncos: vigila los anillos de aviso.
rules.fr: Avec les jets d’eau activés, des geysers jaillissent de la rivière et vous repoussent, toi et les troncs : surveille les anneaux d’avertissement.
rules.de: Bei aktivierten Wasserfontänen brechen Geysire aus dem Fluss und schleudern dich und die Stämme weg: Achte auf die Warnringe.
rules.pt: Com os jatos de água ligados, géiseres irrompem do rio e empurram-te a ti e aos troncos: repara nos anéis de aviso.
rules.it: Con i getti d’acqua attivi, dei geyser eruttano dal fiume e spingono te e i tronchi: fai attenzione agli anelli di avvertimento.

catalog.name: Crazy Logs
catalog.description: Cross the river on spinning logs as many times as you can before time runs out. Most crossings wins.

options.label: Log stability
options.description: How steady the logs are under your feet. 100% = logs never spin, 0% = twice as twitchy.

options.label: Max spin speed
options.description: Fastest a log can turn. Lower is easier to stay on top of.

options.label: Spin fade
options.description: How fast a spinning log calms down (per second). Higher = calms sooner.

options.label: Fall penalty
options.description: Time in the water before you restart from the beginning.

options.label: Fall penalty variance
options.description: How much how long the fall penalty lasts varies, plus or minus.

options.label: Number of logs
options.description: Logs across the river. Fewer logs means wider gaps to hop.

options.label: Log size
options.description: Thickness of each log (what you stand on). Bigger logs are easier to stay on.

options.label: Water jets
options.description: Geysers erupt from the river now and then and shove players and logs.

options.label: Jet variance
options.description: How much the time between jets varies, plus or minus.

options.label: Hop distance
options.description: How far one hop carries you. Logs are 100 apart.
